title: Modified protocol for culturing Drosophila S2 R+ cells and adult plasmatocytes to study actin cytoskeleton dynamics
protocol: Harvest cells from T25 flask using a disposable cell scraper and transfer to a 15 mL sterile tube using a sterile serological pipette.
Take an aliquot of cells (100 μL) and mix it with Trypan Blue stain in a 1:1 ratio in a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Count the live cells (blue cells are dead) using an inverted microscope.
Transfer 2,000,000 cells in 2 mL of SFM4 medium supplemented with antibiotics and seed them in a well of a 6-well plate.
Incubate overnight before transfection.
Prepare two empty 1.5 mL tubes per each DNA or dsRNA on a rack in a sterile cabinet and add 100 μL of SMF4 medium to each.
Add 2 μg of DNA to one prepared 1.5 mL tube and add 18 μL of Cellfectin II transfection reagent to the other tube.
Incubate both tubes for 5 min at room temperature.
Transfer the 100 μL of media plus DNA to the tube containing the 100 μL of SFM4 medium plus Cellfectin II.
Pipette up and down 4 times to mix and incubate at room temperature for 20 min.
Add the DNA and Cellfectin II mix to one well of the 6-well plate prepared on day 1.
Incubate at 25°C for 1–3 days.
Prepare a fresh well with vehicle instead of treatment as a control for cell viability and phenotype detection.
Mix 10 μg of dsRNA with 100 μL of SFM4 media.
Add the dsRNA mix to 2,000,000 cells seeded in one 6-well plate.
Swirl the plate after adding the dsRNA.
Incubate for 3–4 days at 25°C.
Culture Erwinia carotovora carotovora (Ecc15) bacteria in 50 mL of Luria-Bertani (LB) broth.
Inoculate and grow the bacterial culture at 29°C in a shaking incubator set to 200 RPM for 24 hours.
Measure the Optical Density (OD) of 1 mL of the overnight Ecc15 culture in a plastic cuvette at 600 nm using a spectrophotometer.
Calculate the bacterial cell number per mL using the formula: OD600 of 1 = 8 × 10^8 cells/mL for Gram-negative bacteria.
Pellet and resuspend the culture in an appropriate volume to obtain a concentration of 20 × 10^6 cells/mL in PBS 1×.
Scrape cells off the 6-well plate from the incubator and transfer the suspension to a 15 mL tube.
Mix an aliquot of S2R+ cells (100 μL) with Trypan Blue stain in a 1:1 ratio in a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Count live cells using an inverted microscope, noting that blue-stained cells are dead.
Place coverslips coated with concanavalin A prepared on day 1 into a 24-well plate.
Seed 100,000 cells on the coverslip per well in SFM4 medium supplemented with antibiotics.
Seed two coverslips for each treatment and control group.
Incubate the seeded cells for 4 hours at 25°C.
Seed 100,000 cells in an 8-chamber coverglass for live imaging.
Incubate the seeded cells for 4 hours at 25°C.
Coat the 8-chamber cover glass with concanavalin A prior to seeding the cells.
Anesthetize groups of 20 flies (10 males and 10 females) from control group or mutant using gaseous CO2.
Transfer the anesthetized flies onto a 1.5 mL centrifuge tube.
Cover the flies with glass beads and vortex at high intensity for 60 seconds to wound the flies and mobilize plasmatocytes.
Transfer the flies to a glass dissecting dish.
Cut each fly into head, thorax, and abdomen with surgical forceps.
Allow the cut flies to bleed for 1 minute into a glass dish filled with 100 mL of SFM4 Insect Cell Culture Medium containing cOmpleteTM Protease Inhibitor Cocktail.
Filter the cell suspension on 70-μm microcentrifuge filters.
Collect the liquid containing plasmatocytes into a 1.5 mL tube.
Repeat steps 19–23 five times, each time using 20 flies.
Take an aliquot of cells (20 μL) and mix it in a 1.5 mL tube with Trypan Blue stain in a 1:1 ratio.
Count the live cells using an inverted microscope.
Move the cell suspension (around 50,000 cells) into an 8-chamber cover glass coated with concanavalin A.
Seed plasmatocytes from each group of flies in duplicate.
Incubate for 2 hours at 25°C.
Transfer 100 μL of bacterial suspension to one of the two wells.
Mark the well where bacteria were added, representing the stimulated population.
Incubate for an additional 2 hours at 25°C.
Transfer 100 μL of the bacterial suspension to one of the 24-well plates prepared for each treatment.
Incubate for 2 h at 25°C.
Remove media from cells seeded on coverslips.
Rinse cells gently with 500 μL of PBS.
Remove PBS and add 500 μL of 4% formaldehyde to fix the cells.
Incubate for 30 min at room temperature.
Remove formaldehyde by aspiration.
Wash the cells three times with PBST.
Incubate cells in 1× PBS with 5% normal goat serum for 1 h at room temperature.
Dilute primary antibody in blocking buffer at a 1:100 dilution in 1× PBS with 5% normal goat serum.
Incubate the diluted primary antibody for 16 hours at 4°C.
Remove the primary antibody and wash the cells three times with PBST.
Incubate cells for 1 hour at room temperature with appropriate secondary Alexa Fluor antibody at a 1:1000 dilution in 1× PBS with 5% normal goat serum.
Add DAPI at a 1:1000 dilution and fluorescently labeled phalloidin at a 1:500 dilution to visualize the cytoskeleton.
Wash cells four times, each for 10 minutes with PBST.
Mount cells in Pro-Gold Antifade Reagent.
Remove excess mounting medium by aspiration.
Allow slides to dry completely before imaging.
Image slides using ZEISS LSM 880 with a 100× oil immersion objective and NA = 1.4.
Analyze the images following the ImageJ protocol adopted for this purpose.
